The cause lives in Pod stdout immediately BEFORE the node-reload sequence (search the RunPod console log for Traceback/Error); it is not in app.log, which showed only 'Model cache reseeded ... no restart needed'.

ITEM 2 - GATE 8 MUST CHECK REQUIRED INPUTS, NOT JUST CLASS EXISTENCE. Asked for by the MPI-498 session (message 060955d5, acknowledged; reply 29d60d5f). Gate 8 proves every Mpi* class_type EXISTS at the pinned commit - class existence was never the failing condition, which is why MPI-498 survived two releases and two matrices. TRAP, MEASURED: ~120 Mpi* nodes in the shipped graphs build INPUT_TYPES PROGRAMMATICALLY (MpiAnySwitch, MpiAnySwitch10, MpiPacker, MpiClearVram, MpiSimpleBoolean, MpiBoolean), so a static/AST parse sees no required-input literal and silently reports 0 holes for the MAJORITY of first-party nodes. Gate 8 must EXECUTE INPUT_TYPES at the pinned commit, or read /object_info from a Pod - never parse source.

ITEM 3 - ONE FULL MATRIX for clean evidence. release:check refuses counts.fail > 0. A --models run OVERWRITES smoke-evidence.json with only those models and would discard the 33 passes and trip the coverage check, so scoping is NOT a shortcut to a green file. BEFORE that run: turn 'Stage all models on connect' back ON in Settings (the user already intends to), and expect it to be markedly faster - this matrix ran entirely on cold volume reads.

key_decisions: The OOM explanation for the h3/t2v_ms restart was WITHDRAWN after the user pointed out the Pod has more RAM and VRAM than his machine and the workflow runs locally - and h3/i2v_ms then passed at 260s on the same Pod. It is recorded as UNEXPLAINED rather than replaced with another guess. Do not re-derive OOM.

MPI-498's severity is now CONFIRMED by the MPI-498 session, not by this one: MpiLoadImageFromPath subclasses PreviewImage with OUTPUT_NODE=True, so the input LOADER is a valid output node with no upstream deps. It survives validation while every real PreviewImage is dropped - PiD was returning THE INPUT IMAGE, not a degraded generation. That is why it read as 4s/1-media.
Scoping the re-run with --models is NOT a shortcut: it overwrites the evidence file with only those models.
The user wants to be PRESENT for GPU runs. Ask before starting one.
constraints: NEVER delete or shrink network volume aghcuvg7nl (cubric-smoke, 450 GB, EU-RO-1) - the user records YouTube videos off its model set. Always --keep-volume --volume aghcuvg7nl. The runner's own teardown prompt argues FOR deleting it and that framing is wrong.

NO OTHER SESSION MAY CREATE A POD WHILE A MATRIX RUNS. The orphan sweep deletes by NAME and cannot tell a peer's live Pod from a stray - it killed Pod 5im0byu8auhi12 mid-generation on 2026-08-08 and cost a full matrix. That is a real defect and is NOT yet carded.
A PIPE SWALLOWS THE RUNNER'S EXIT CODE - a trailing echo of the status reports the wrong value. Read the printed summary.
CANCEL ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING: delete the Pod FIRST, then cancel a download. Cancel with a Pod attached deletes partials off the volume.

THE TREE IS SHARED. Commit by explicit pathspec. board.json, state/index.json and events.jsonl are co-owned and were deliberately LEFT UNCOMMITTED - a peer session has unstaged edits in them. comfy_workflows/* is claimed by the MPI-498 session; js/services/comfyController.js by MPI-495.
BASH HEREDOCS HALVE BACKSLASHES on this box even with a quoted delimiter. Write backslash-bearing files with python. Also: python on Windows cannot open Git Bash's /tmp path - use the scratchpad dir.
